color: rgb(11, 46, 59) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
• Splunk Web app, React UI in an iframe, Simple and Advanced modes
• Command Center and Use Case Explorer
• Generate: Quick Generate, Scenarios, Scenario Studio, Industry Studio
• Observe: Live Runs, Dashboard Studio, Pipeline Health
• Catalog views: Cisco 100, Cisco Coverage, Security Sources, Provenance
• System: Connections, Destination Manager

div.style: color: rgb(11, 46, 59) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
• 349 sourcetypes from 88 vendors
• Generator tier: 159 native engine, 143 recorded sample replay, 47 no generator yet
• Provenance labels: native contract, Splunk contract, NetSpout schema
• 33 replay packs

div.style: color: rgb(11, 46, 59) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
• 372 scenarios defined, 372 runnable on main (the released app: 148)
• Incident packs, replay packs, NetFlow solution (10 NF scenarios), Cisco 100, industry packs
• 224 declarative contracts: shared nodes, ordered phases, streams
• Fidelity of the 224: 10 vendor-native, 30 mixed, 184 modeled

div.style: color: rgb(11, 46, 59) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
• SplunkLogEngine vendor log formatters
• Native protocol engines: SNMP v2c, gNMI, NetFlow v9 and IPFIX encoders
• Recorded sample replay
• Modeled state events: netspout:scenario:state, labeled MODELED_NETSPOUT_SCHEMA
• Fault injection and topology graph

div.style: color: rgb(11, 46, 59) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
• HEC: logs to the event index, metrics to a metric index
• Native listeners: syslog, SNMP, gNMI
• IPFIX over UDP to the GoFlow2 collector, then a forwarder to HEC
• Delivery monitor: generated, attempts, accepted, rejected, indexed (verified)

div.style: color: rgb(11, 46, 59) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
• netspout_gateway: persistconn REST handler in the app
• Dashboard Studio pf_* views, bound to a run ID
• Verification search by run ID is the only source of indexed
• Connection Center authorizes indexes before a run

div.style: color: rgb(11, 46, 59) !important; font-size: 17px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
• Released: netspout.spl app plus pulseforge-engine.tar.gz, Docker evaluation stack, netspout_cloud.spl (Splunk Cloud dashboards only, Splunk Cloud not validated)
• Experimental, not released: single-package installer
• Loopback-only listeners by default; engine health endpoint
